entities.summary: The Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute (SLMath), formerly the Mathematical Sciences Research Institute (MSRI), is an independent nonprofit mathematical research institution on the University of California campus in Berkeley, California. It is a center for research in mathematics. Each year, over 1,700 mathematicians spend time at MSRI. Mathematical Sciences Research Institute is a research institute in Americas, established in 1982. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
